name: agent-config-reviewer
title_zh: 给 Claude Code 配置做一次全身体检和修复
tagline_zh: CLAUDE.md 越堆越乱、权限时松时紧、hook 悄悄失效？让这个 skill 从 .claude 到 .mc。
tagline_en: CLAUDE.md sprawl, loose permissions, dead hooks? This skill audits .claude to .mcp.json layer by layer and pins.
desc_en: Review, validate, and optimize a target Claude Code configuration and Claude Agent SDK integration from Claude Code or Codex. Use for audits or remediations involving CLAUDE.md, .claude settings/rules/skills/agents/hooks/commands/output styles, .mcp.json, worktrees, permissions, sandboxing, SDK setting sources, tool surfaces, cross-file reachability, and regression validation.
why_zh: 不止读文件——它交叉验证跨文件可达性、SDK 设置源与工具面，能发现单看某处永远看不出的断裂。
why_en: It doesn't just read files—it cross-checks reachability across files, SDK setting sources, and tool surfaces to catch breaks no.
limit_zh: 只针对 Claude Code / Agent SDK 配置域；不碰业务代码逻辑。需要本机有 claude 或 cod。
limit_en: Scoped to Claude Code/Agent SDK config only—no business logic. Requires claude or codex CLI locally and an initialized target project. Outputs.
